summary: Completed testing of P0 Admin bug fixes: PDF file viewing, version history for emissions, and country-specific emission factor lookup. All backend tests pass (8/8). Frontend verification confirms features are working.

issues: React hydration warning about <span> inside <select> - cosmetic, not affecting functionality

feature_1_pdf_file_viewing.details: The /api/files/{file_id}/view endpoint now allows PDFs (not just images). Backend code at lines 1695-1726 checks content_type against 'application/pdf' and sets Content-Disposition: inline for browser display.
feature_1_pdf_file_viewing.ui_verified: Code in Facilities.js (lines 439-459) shows View/Download buttons for uploaded files
endpoints_tested: GET /api/files/{id}/view - Returns PDF with proper content-type and inline disposition

feature_2_version_history.details: Version history now shows 'Created' entry when emission is created (action='created') and 'Updated' entries for subsequent edits (action='updated'). Backend code at lines 1033-1045 creates initial history entry on POST /api/emissions, and lines 1095-1107 create update history entry on PUT.
feature_2_version_history.ui_verified: UI shows 'Created by: admin@ghg.com' and 'Updated by:' info on emission cards. Version History dialog shows Created/Updated entries with timestamps and user emails.
endpoints_tested: POST /api/emissions - Creates emission + history entry with action='created'
PUT /api/emissions/{id} - Updates emission + adds history entry with action='updated'
GET /api/emissions/{id}/history - Returns history sorted by changed_at ascending

feature_3_country_specific_factors.details: Emissions.js handleCategoryChange (lines 101-164) now prioritizes country-specific emission factors. Logic: 1) Find factor matching facility country, 2) Fall back to Global factor if no country match, 3) Use any matching factor as last resort.
feature_3_country_specific_factors.ui_verified: Facility dropdown shows country in parentheses. EmissionFactorResponse model includes 'region' field for country-specific matching.
endpoints_tested: POST /api/super-admin/emission-factors - Create factors with region field
GET /api/emission-factors - Returns factors with region info

feature_4_filters_overlap.details: Emissions page filters use proper grid layout (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2) at lines 750-826 in Emissions.js. Filter section has proper spacing and responsiveness.
feature_4_filters_overlap.ui_verified: Filters displayed correctly without overlap - Facility, Category, Date Range, Clear Filters all properly spaced

critical_code_review_comments: Note: Older emissions created before the fix don't have version history entries - only new/updated emissions will have history
seed_data_creation: Created test emissions with version history entries during pytest
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Admin fixes verified: 1) PDF viewing works via /api/files/{id}/view with inline disposition, 2) Version history tracks Created/Updated with action field and user emails, 3) Country-specific emission factors prioritized in Emissions.js handleCategoryChange. Old emissions won't have history entries - only new/updated ones.
testing_method: pytest for backend API tests + Playwright browser automation for UI verification
